verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The train slows for a station no one gets off at.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Someone left a window cracked open all winter
just to hear how far the cold could travel

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Someone else's dog knows the way home better than I do,
stopping at corners I would have walked right past

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I keep a spare key to a house
that changed its locks years ago,
still hoping it means something to carry

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the moon has been full for three nights running
no one mentions it, everyone just seems tired,
their shadows a little longer at the edges

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I keep forgetting which mug is mine at work
so I just drink from whichever one is warm,
telling myself this is a kind of belonging

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the dog again, three blocks on,
sniffing at a gate that isn't home
but pauses there like it could be

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the bus driver waves at every stop
even the ones where no one's waiting,
like he's practicing for someone

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the streetlight flickers on too early
gathering moths that haven't decided yet
if the dark has really come

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
my neighbor's radio through the wall
same three songs since spring,
like a promise nobody made but keeps

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the mail slot clicks twice before it settles,
some letter changing its mind
halfway through arriving

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the barista writes a name that isn't mine
on the wrong cup,
and for a second I consider becoming him

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the elevator stops on every floor tonight
no one gets on
but the numbers keep believing in us

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the porch light left on for a guest who canceled
still it burns,
faithful to a version of tonight that didn't happen

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the vending machine eats my coin without a word,
somewhere inside it
a decision is still being made

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the crosswalk counts down from ten
long after I've crossed,
teaching the empty street to hurry
